title: 5 New MSFS Airports on PC This Week 🚨 Porto LPPR, Incheon RKSI, Istanbul LTFJ & More!
description:
In this week’s MSFS 2020 Marketplace Update, we are exploring massive new hub airports! The headline releases for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 this week include the highly anticipated RKSI Incheon International Airport and LTFJ Istanbul Sabiha Gökçen. Whether you are looking for long-haul routes or busy European hubs, this MSFS PC Marketplace update has you covered.

We also take a look at new regional airports like LPPR Porto, LFBI Poitiers, and KSVR South Valley, making this a huge week for MSFS new airports and MSFS new scenery on PC.

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 msfscenerybuilders: KSVR South Valley Regional Airport (perfect for regional hops and GA vibes)
🛫 France VFR: LFBI Poitiers Biard Airport (a great new stop for relaxed European routes)
🛫 Taimodels: LPPR Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport (awesome gateway for Iberia flying)
🛫 SceneryTR Design: LTFJ Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Airport (busy-feeling ops and variety in one spot)
🛫 SiamFlight: RKSI Incheon International Airport (ideal for long-haul legs and big-airport energy)

🌆 New sceneries added this week (PC)
The following sceneries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🌆 Dreamscenery: VFR Object Straits of Hormuz Region (extra regional atmosphere for your low-and-slow exploring)

If this update helped you decide what to pick up, hit Like, Subscribe, and drop a comment with which airport you’re flying into first (and what aircraft you’ll take there) 😄

✈️ See you in the skies!
